scope: Standalone owned module; no Cargo, workspace, native guest, WASM or benchmark
normalization: Caller-supplied repository/output paths replaced by labels; no other text changed.

result.latencyMeaning: Explicit virtual1us reset protocol, not hardware settling/KM edge/crypto frequency

actualBoundary.source: Existing integration log, read only; no new native run

inputContract.sec_source_hz: Only actual Some48M/Some480M pre-DPA availability, not functional rate
inputContract.apb_available: Explicit actual APB availability; required even for configuration POR reads
inputContract.crypto_domain_available: Caller proves strict ideal-awake virtual domain conditions; not physical power-ready
inputContract.fuses: Known DPA0 / flash encryption=false / force KM flash=false; None rejects runtime qualification
inputContract.ownedGates: Actual POWER2 and CONF clock1/reset0 plus real assert-release sequence
inputContract.dpa: Named mask7 config only; new completion only when both register/eFuse levels0

eventContract.unknownLoss: Cancel active protocol once; restoration does not restart without actual new reset
eventContract.sameCycle: Old-context completion precedes newly observed inputs; parent watchdog/reset arbitration has priority
eventContract.roReady: HeaderPOR1 has zero completions; bus writes cannot set it; STATE/STATIC runtime require actual completion
eventContract.deadlineOverflow: Release rejects atomically; no saturation into invented due time
eventContract.reset: CPU/LP retain HP latches/pending; HP/Chip restore/withdraw; functional retention only

limits: No Bus/lib/Soc/Clock/eFuse/PMU changes; only new private component and evidence.
No actual crypto functional rate, random divider, physical latency, deployed/provisioned key, keyvalid/result/data/IRQ or START/CONTINUE.
DPA selector descriptions conflict; only source-proven KnownOff protocol qualification, other named values stored as config.
PCR configuration availability is distinct from qualified KM runtime observations.

staticChecks.manualPrivacyReview: Public source URLs, relative paths, hashes, PC/counts only; caller paths normalized; private native logs outside Git.

stdoutRetention.historicalOutputFields: Preserved unchanged; see immutable sourceReceipt and distinct raw/normalized output records
